name: Porphyritic-Hamada
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against a subterranean ocean, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Debris from the starship crash site (colony ship) rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
Wreck-divers talk about the site in lowered voices, and salvage guilds post hazard bonuses that only grow.
